source: Baseball Savant (Statcast) leaderboards and MLB Stats API, 2015-2026

regression.hitter: wOBA drops 30+ points the next season (about 15-20 wRC+), among hitters who still get 200+ PA.
regression.pitcher: ERA rises 1+ run vs. league the next season, among pitchers who still throw 40+ IP.
regression.eligibility: Hitters with 400+ PA and a wOBA 15+ points above league in 2026. Starters with 90+ IP and an ERA 0.4+ below league, or relievers with 40+ IP and an ERA 1+ below league. The probability assumes he plays.

bounceback.hitter: Back within 15 points of his two-year wOBA (league-adjusted) over 250+ PA the next season. Not playing counts as no bounceback.
bounceback.pitcher: ERA back within 0.5 runs of his two-year level (league-adjusted) over 40+ IP the next season. Not pitching counts as no bounceback.
bounceback.eligibility: Hitters with 600+ PA and an above-average wOBA across 2024-25 whose 2026 wOBA fell 25+ points (150+ PA). Pitchers with 100+ IP and a better-than-league ERA across 2024-25 whose 2026 ERA rose 1+ run (25+ IP).
